title: Making Your Money Work for You: Budgeting Basics
summary: Learn how to manage your money effectively by creating a budget and understanding different savings options available in Mexico.

sections.heading: Why Budget?
sections.body: A budget is a plan for your money. It helps you track where your money goes, so you can decide where you want it to go. This is especially important when you're starting your career and managing your own income for the first time.

sections.heading: Saving vs. Spending
sections.body: Every peso you spend is a peso you can't save. By planning your spending, you can free up money to save. Even small amounts saved regularly can grow over time, especially when put into accounts that earn interest.

sections.heading: Choosing the Right Savings Tool
sections.body: Mexico offers various ways to save, from keeping cash at home (which loses value to inflation) to government-backed options like CETES through cetesdirecto. Each has different risks, rewards, and access times.

example.title: Sofia's Budget Plan
example.body: Sofia just got her first job and earns MXN 10,000 a month. She wants to save for a new laptop. She creates a budget: MXN 4,000 for rent, MXN 2,000 for food and transport, MXN 1,000 for fun, and decides to save MXN 3,000. She opens an account with cetesdirecto to put her savings, earning about 6.3% a year.

takeaway: A budget helps you control your money, allowing you to save and grow your wealth over time.
